name: GeForce NOW Browser
postStartCommand: docker start chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --name=chromium --restart unless-stopped --security-opt seccomp=unconfined -p 3000:3000 --shm-size=2gb -v ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.chrome-data:/config -e CUSTOM_RES_W=1280 -e CUSTOM_RES_H=720 -e CUSTOM_RES_FPS=60 -e CHROME_CLI=https://play.geforcenow.com lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest
